{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Side dishes|Side dishes]]

This recipe is incredibly quick to prepare, rich in flavor, and makes a great side dish. The butter adds flavor but can be excluded for vegan/low-fat diets.

==Ingredients==
*½–1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1–2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] or [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]]
*1 head (3–4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] of leaves) [[Cookbook:Tatsoi|tat soi]] or any other dark leafy green, base removed (tear into smaller pieces if using a large leaf plant like [[Cookbook:Chard|chard]])
*[[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|Soy sauce]]

==Procedure==

#Rinse greens thoroughly. 
#Melt butter and olive oil in a [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]] or [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium-high heat.
#Add garlic and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until golden.
#Stir in tat soi and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly wilted.
#Remove from heat and cover, allowing the greens to [[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] in the pan for a minute or two.
#When ready to serve, toss with about 1 tbsp soy sauce.
